title: Time the 0.3.0 reader against 0.2.1 with repeated interleaved runs
body: 0.3.0's read speed has single-run timings only; CHANGELOG.md gives figures for 0.2.1 and none for 0.3.0. Time both on the same data in one session, interleaved, with min, median and max, and say where a difference is within noise. The 331 GB table has never been timed. The crate has no benches/ directory. CONCERNS.md said the nail-benchmarks benchmark needed its meta calls moved to the 0.2 API first; nail-benchmarks moved to toil 0.3.0 on 2026-09-26 (its commit 1f03ac5), so check whether that still holds.
